sn35.244:1.1: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbesaṃ yeva dukkhadhammānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn35.244:1.2: tathā kho panassa kāmā diṭṭhā honti, yathāssa kāme passato yo kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapariḷāho so nānuseti.
sn35.244:1.3: tathā kho panassa cāro ca vihāro ca anubuddho hoti, yathā carantaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā nānussavanti.
sn35.244:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbesaṃyeva dukkhadhammānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
sn35.244:2.2: iti rūpaṃ, itirūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthagamo
sn35.244:2.4: iti vedanāya samudayo, iti vedanāya atthagamo; iti saññā …pe… iti saññāya atthagamo
sn35.244:2.6: iti saṅkhārānaṃ samudayo, iti saṅkhārānaṃ atthagamo; iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthagamoti.
sn35.244:2.7: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbesaṃyeva dukkhadhammānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn35.244:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhuno kāmā diṭṭhā honti yathāssa kāme passato yo kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapariḷāho so nānuseti.
sn35.244:3.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave aṅgārakāsu sādhikaporisā puṇṇā aṅgārānaṃ vītaccikānaṃ vītadhūmānaṃ. atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikkūlo. tamenaṃ dve balavanto purisā nānābāhāsu gahetvā taṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ upakaḍḍheyyuṃ. so iti citi ceva kāyaṃ sannāmeyya.
sn35.244:3.4: ñātaṃ hi bhikkhave tassa purisassa hoti: ‘imañcāhaṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ papatissāmi, tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkha’nti.
sn35.244:3.5: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno aṅgārakāsūpamā kāmā diṭṭhā honti, yathāssa kāme passato, yo kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapariḷāho so nānuseti.
sn35.244:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhuno cāro ca vihāro ca anubuddho hoti, yathā carantaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā nānussavanti,
sn35.244:4.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso bahukaṇṭakaṃ dāyaṃ paviseyya; tassassa puratopi kaṇṭako, pacchato pi kaṇṭako, uttaratopi kaṇṭako, dakkhiṇatopi kaṇṭako, heṭṭhatopi kaṇṭako, uparitopi kaṇṭako. so sato va abhikkameyya sato paṭikkameyya; mā maṃ kaṇṭakoti.
sn35.244:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ ayaṃ vuccati ariyassa vinaye kaṇṭako; taṃ kaṇṭakoti
sn35.244:4.4: iti viditvā saṃvaro ca asaṃvaro ca veditabbo.
sn35.244:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe adhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe vyāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso,
sn35.244:5.3: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti; sotena saddaṃ sutvā …pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā …pe…
sn35.244:5.4: jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā …pe… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā …pe…
sn35.244:5.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme adhimuccati, appiyarūpe dhamme vyāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso,
sn35.244:5.6: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
sn35.244:6.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe nādhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe na vyāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso,
sn35.244:6.3: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti; sotena saddaṃ sutvā …pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā …pe…
sn35.244:6.4: jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā …pe… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā …pe…
sn35.244:6.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme nādhimuccati, appiyarūpe dhamme na vyāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati appamāṇa cetaso,
sn35.244:6.6: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti;
sn35.244:7.1: tassa ce bhikkhave, bhikkhuno evaṃ carato evaṃ viharato kadāci karahaci satisammosā uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā sarasaṅkappā saññojaniyā, dandho bhikkhave, satuppādo. atha kho naṃ khippameva pajahati vinodeti, byantīkaroti, anabhāvaṃ gameti.
sn35.244:8.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, puriso divasasantatte ayokaṭāhe dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni nipāteyya. dandho bhikkhave udakaphusitānaṃ nipāto, atha kho naṃ khippameva parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya.
sn35.244:8.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, tassa ce bhikkhuno evaṃ carato evaṃ viharato kadāci karahaci satisammosā uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā sarasaṅkappā saññojaniyā; dandho bhikkhave, satuppādo. atha kho naṃ khippameva pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti.
sn35.244:8.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno cāro ca vihāro ca anubuddho hoti yathā carantaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā nānussavanti.
sn35.244:8.4: tañce bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ evaṃ carantaṃ evaṃ viharantaṃ rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātī vā sālohitā vā bhogehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyyuṃ:
sn35.244:8.5: ehambho purisa, kinte ime kāsāvā anudahanti?
sn35.244:8.7: ehi hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjassu, puññāni ca karohīti.
sn35.244:8.8: so vata bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ caranto evaṃ viharanto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn35.244:9.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave gaṅgānadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā. atha mahājanakāyo āgaccheyya kuddālapiṭakaṃ ādāya: mayaṃ imaṃ gaṅgānadiṃ pacchāninnaṃ karissāma pacchāpoṇaṃ pacchāpabbhāranti.
sn35.244:9.3: api nu so mahājanakāyo gaṅgānadiṃ pacchāninnaṃ kareyya pacchāpoṇaṃ pacchāpabbhāranti?
sn35.244:9.6: gaṅgānadī bhante pācīna ninnā pācīna poṇā pācīna pabbhārā,
sn35.244:9.7: sā na sukarā pacchāninnaṃ kātuṃ pacchāpoṇaṃ pacchāpabbhāraṃ.
sn35.244:9.8: yāvadeva ca pana so mahājanakāyo kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assāti.
sn35.244:9.9: evameva kho bhikkhave tañce bhikkhuṃ evaṃ carantaṃ evaṃ viharantaṃ rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātī vā sālohitā vā bhogehi abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyyuṃ:
sn35.244:9.12: ehi hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjassu, puññāni ca karohī”ti.
sn35.244:9.13: so pana bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃ caranto evaṃ viharanto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati,
sn35.244:9.15: yaṃ hi taṃ bhikkhave cittaṃ dīgharattaṃ vivekaninnaṃ vivekapoṇaṃ vivekapabbhāraṃ. tatha hīnāyāvattissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti.
